document.abstract: The evolution of disk drives from being simple devices on an independent “storage-only” bus, to being self-sufficient targets on an advanced multipurpose network marks the start of a new paradigm in the design of distributed computing systems. Understanding this new design approach and incorporating it into multichannel VDR systems will pave the way toward the goal of an integrated digital broadcast environment.

authors.bio: Todd S. Roth is vice-president, research and development, for ASC Audio Video Corp. He directs all research and product development efforts including technical design and programming applications for the company's video server division. An expert on the subject of computerbased video handling systems, Roth has a patent pending for shared video data storage systems. Additionally, Roth is credited with the design and implementation of the first software-based RAID disk technology. He has published numerous articles and presented technical papers for leading industry resources, such as Broadcasting Engineering magazine, the IBC, SMPTE, and others. Roth holds a BSE degree from Arizona State University.
